Admin.title: Admin
Admin.description: Administrator user authorized to manage knowledge items.

addedAt.description: Timestamp when the admin was designated.

isInitialAdmin.description: Whether this is the first bootstrapping admin.

KnowledgeItem.title: KnowledgeItem
KnowledgeItem.description: Document or web link containing technical knowledge.

type.description: Type of item: file or url.

fileType.description: File extension: pdf, docx, txt, csv, xlsx, image.

category.description: Category: Pagos, Garantias, Precios, Requisitos, Procedimientos, General.

url.description: Web URL if item is a link.

storageUrl.description: Firebase Storage download URL for original file.

content.description: Extracted text content (first chunk or full text).

hasChunks.description: Whether content is split into subcollection chunks.

totalParts.description: Total number of parts if chunked.

updatedBy.description: Email of user who performed last update.

createdBy.description: Email of user who created the item.

KnowledgeChunk.title: KnowledgeChunk
KnowledgeChunk.description: Chunked text partition of large documents.

UnansweredQuestion.title: UnansweredQuestion
UnansweredQuestion.description: Log of questions where information was not found in knowledge base.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the question was asked.

/knowledge_items/{itemId}.description: Collection of knowledge items (files and URLs).

/knowledge_items/{itemId}/chunks/{chunkI.description: Subcollection of text chunks for large files exceeding single doc limits.

/preguntas_sin_respuesta/{questionId}.description: Log of unanswered questions for administrator review.
